onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/statemachine/properties/jump_state.schema.json, set js_c_style to {{js_c_style}}]
Set jump style to {{js_c_style}} by adjusting JumpAbility.jumpImpulse: low_hop~2.5, standard=5.0, high_leap~10.0.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/statemachine/properties/jump_state.schema.json, set js_c_grace to {{js_c_grace}}]
Set coyoteTime and jumpBufferTime grace windows to {{js_c_grace}} preset values.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/statemachine/properties/jump_state.schema.json, set js_t_impulse to {{js_t_impulse}}]
Set JumpAbility.jumpImpulse to {{js_t_impulse}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/statemachine/properties/jump_state.schema.json, set js_t_cooldown to {{js_t_cooldown}}]
Set JumpAbility.jumpCooldown to {{js_t_cooldown}} ms.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/statemachine/properties/jump_state.schema.json, set js_t_coyote to {{js_t_coyote}}]
Set JumpAbility.coyoteTime to {{js_t_coyote}} ms.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/statemachine/properties/jump_state.schema.json, set js_t_buffer to {{js_t_buffer}}]
Set JumpAbility.jumpBufferTime to {{js_t_buffer}} ms.
